english.notes:
(i) See regulation 6 for application of the offence to bodies corporate.
(ii) Regulation 7 provides a defence of due diligence.
(iii) Regulation 9 provides for civil sanctions. A person may not be convicted of this criminal offence following a civil fixed monetary penalty, compliance notice or third party undertaking in respect of the act or omission giving rise to the penalty (paragraph 8(1) of the Schedule).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limits for prosecutions:
None
